records.issue_text: delete in embeddable-host.js.es6 uses destroyRecord().then() with no .catch(popupAjaxError), so a failed destroy leaves the row in place with an unhandled rejection
records.rationale: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6, the delete action calls this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...) without any .catch(popupAjaxError). Save handles errors via .catch(popupAjaxError), but delete does not, so a failed destroy would result in an unhandled promise rejection and no user-visible error while the row remains.
